Eligibility: need 1200 units from one supplier in <=30 days.

- Alpha: max 1700 >=1200 qualifies quantity. 18 days <=30 qualifies time.
- Bravo: max 1000 <1200 fails quantity. 10 days qualifies time. Disqualified.
- Cobalt: max 2400 >=1200 qualifies quantity. 35 days >30 fails time. Disqualified.

Only Alpha qualifies.

Alpha cost for 1200 units, full precision, unrounded through steps:
Goods in EUR = 11.91 * 1200 = 14292
Goods in USD = 14292 * 1.08 = 15435.36
Goods + shipping = 15435.36 + 600.00 = 16035.36
Duty = 0.08 * 16035.36 = 1282.8288
Total landed = 16035.36 + 1282.8288 = 16035.36 * 1.08 = 17318.1888

Cross-check in reverse:
17318.1888 / 1.08 = 16035.36 goods+shipping
16035.36 - 600 = 15435.36 goods USD
15435.36 / 1.08 = 14292 goods EUR
14292 / 1200 = 11.91 matches unit price.

Rounded for final presentation to cents: 17318.19

For reference disqualified totals:
Bravo 1200 would be (1959.48*1200*0.0067+600)*1.04 = 17008.387968 but fails quantity.
Cobalt 1200 would be 11.98*1200+1500 = 15876 but fails deadline.

Lowest qualified is Alpha.
